sources.title: GitHub - rounak-acharyya/NYC-Traffic-Prediction
sources.snippet: This project leverages Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to optimize traffic management for emergency vehicles by predicting congestion and suggesting real-time route adjustments. The model is trained using NYC Open Data and employs a Random Forest Regressor (RFR) for traffic volume prediction.

sources.title: AI could predict traffic jams years before they happen
sources.snippet: Heavy traffic fills a busy New York City street, where researchers are testing AI tools designed to predict future congestion. Credit: Shutterstock September 23, 2026 AI could predict traffic jams years before they happen A new AI system could help cities predict where traffic congestion will form, giving planners a chance to respond before problems get worse.
